settings.scanWhat: Motiff Lab reads the notes from a PDF or photo of printed music, and writes down the notes it hears in an audio or video recording. It asks before each send.

settings.scanConnected: Connected: the scan server runs {0}. Scanning is on.
settings.scanElsewhere: This address is another computer, so pages and recordings you send leave this device. Each send asks first.

photos.title: Photos of pages
photos.empty: Photograph the pages in order: the camera finds each page, crops it and straightens it. Or pick photos you have.
photos.reviewHint: Drag a page to change the order. Turn a page that lies sideways or upside down, take out one you do not need, or photograph it again.
